title: Things That Fight Back
tagline: monsters, combat, and a game that can kill you
hints: `monsterAt` walks monsters_ and returns `m.get()` for the first LIVING one on that square, or `nullptr` if there is none. `.get()` borrows the raw pointer without giving away ownership.
`step` decides between two actions: if `monsterAt(nx, ny)` gave you something, attack it and do NOT move. Otherwise check the wall, then move.
Adjacency is `(abs(dx) + abs(dy)) == 1` - orthogonal only, and not the square the player is standing on. `#include <cstdlib>` for abs.
Order inside a turn: the player acts, then monstersAct() runs, then draw(). Keep that order or your dice will not match.
In draw(), build each row from `dungeon_.tileAt(x, y)`, then overwrite with any living monster's glyph, then overwrite with '@'. Player on top, always.
